card_ai_overview_analysis.name: AI Overview Competitor Analysis
card_ai_overview_analysis.desc: Systematic analysis of Google AI Overview citations across 40 healthcare keywords. Documented citation pattern frequency, listicle vs tabular trigger factors, and publisher authority thresholds.

items.name: Keyword Selection & Benchmark Query List (40 medical queries)
SERP Scraping & AI Overview capture across Google US

comments.text: Found that tabular data, HTML bulleted lists, and concise 40-word direct Q&A definitions have a 3x higher citation rate in Google AI Overviews for medical symptom and treatment queries.
Excellent findings. Incorporating these formatting guidelines immediately into our content strategy for client service pages.

items.name: Audit brand mention citations in Perplexity & ChatGPT

comments.text: Perplexity citations heavily favor Wikipedia, Wikidata, and structured author schema with verifiable medical credentials.
Finalized the AEO FAQ blueprint. Planning to roll it out initially for Precision Podiatry and Advanced Well MD.
